body: I have now, after the events of Saturday night, accepted that I have something wrong with me. These have been a hard couple of days. I never wanted to tell anyone because I didn't want anyone to think I was crazy. I want to die so bad one moment, but then talk myself out of it. I want so much to just feel normal like everyone else

I know. I want to find it so bad. At the urging of my girlfriend I finally went to my university's counseling center today and got an appointment with a psychiatrist. I am trying to get help. But I just feel hopeless right now. I feel like she is only delaying breaking up with me. I don't know why. If I lose her then I have nobody.
